CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
STANDARD RATE This rate is for metered non-residential and non-farm loads greater than 75 kilovolt
amperes (kVA) and up to and including 3,000 kVA, served through customer-owned
transformation and to which no other rates apply. Rate Codes* E07 E08 E10 E12
Effective (Urban) (Rural) (closed to new (closed to new February 1, 2026 customers) customers)
Supply voltage 25kV & less 25kV & less 72kV 100kV & above
Basic monthly charge $289.55 $289.55 $299.50 $340.35
Demand Charge Per kVA of recorded $20.037 $20.037 $15.502 $15.019
demand each month
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 7.288¢ 7.288¢ 5.677¢ 5.536¢
MINIMUM BILL The basic monthly charge plus $5.059/kVA of the maximum demand registered in the
defined billing periods between May 1st to October 31st and November 1st to April
30th.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
RECORDED DEMAND
The maximum kVA demand registered during the current month, OR
For services with approved time-of-day metering, the greater of the maximum kVA demand registered between the hours of 07:00 to 22:00, Monday through
Friday, excluding statutory holidays OR 85 per cent of the maximum kVA
demand registered at any other time during the current month.
AVAILABILITY E10 and E12 rates are closed to new customers.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
SMALL COMMERCIAL RATE This rate is for metered commercial and municipal loads up to and including 75 kilovolt
amperes (kVA) served through customer-owned transformation and to which no other
rates apply. Rate Codes* E77 E78
Effective February 1, 2026 (Urban) (Rural)
Supply voltage 25kV & less 25kV & less
Basic monthly charge $42.79 $42.79
Demand Charge First 50 kVA/month $0 $0
Balance $/kVA $20.061 $20.061
Energy Charge First block kWh/month 14,500 kWh 13,000 kWh
First block (¢/kWh) 15.602¢ 15.602¢
Balance (¢/kWh) 6.393¢ 6.393¢
MINIMUM BILL The basic monthly charge plus $5.059/kVA of the maximum demand over 50 kVA
registered in the defined billing periods between May 1st to October 31st and
November 1st to April 30th.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
POWER TIME-OF-USE RATE
This rate is for large commercial, farm, and industrial loads served through customer-
owned transformation as an alternative to SaskPower Supplied Transformation -
Standard Rates and Customer-Owned Transformation - Power Standard Rates. Rate Codes* E82 E83 E84
Effective February 1, 2026
Supply voltage 25kV 72kV 100kV & above
Basic monthly charge $7,022.82 $8,151.50 $8,731.50
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand $18.700 $15.203 $12.038
each month
Energy Charge On-peak energy charge 7.070¢ 7.023¢ 6.833¢
(¢/kWh) Off-peak energy charge 6.070¢ 6.023¢ 5.833¢
(¢/kWh)
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge.
RECORDED DEMAND
The monthly recorded demand is the maximum kVA demand registered during the
current month.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
BILLING DEMAND
The monthly billing demand is the monthly recorded demand, but the billing demand shall not be less than 75 per cent of the maximum billing demand in the preceding 11
months.
ON-PEAK ENERGY CONSUMPTION The monthly energy consumed between the hours of 7:00 to 22:00, Monday through
Friday, excluding statutory holidays.
OFF-PEAK ENERGY CONSUMPTION
The monthly energy consumed in all hours except for the on-peak hours.
AVAILABILITY
These time-of-use rates are optional - at the customer's request. Once a customer
requests to change to these rates they must stay on for at least one year.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
POWER STANDARD RATE
This rate is for large commercial and industrial loads served through customer-owned
transformation as an alternative to SaskPower Supplied Transformation - Standard
Rates. Rate Codes* E22 E23 E24
Effective February 1, 2026
Supply voltage 25kV 72kV 100kV & above
Basic monthly charge $7,022.82 $8,151.50 $8,731.50
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand $18.700 $15.203 $12.038
each month
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 6.497¢ 6.450¢ 6.260¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge.
BILLING DEMAND
The monthly billing demand is the monthly recorded demand, but the billing demand shall not be less than 75 per cent of the maximum billing demand in the preceding 11
months.

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
POWER STANDARD RATE - CAPACITY RESERVATION SERVICE
This rate applies to Power Class customers requiring capacity reservation who are served
through customer-owned transformation and self-generating a portion of their power
requirements using non-renewable sources. Rate Codes* N22 N23 N24
Effective February 1, 2026
Supply voltage 25kV 72kV 100kV & above
Basic monthly charge $7,022.82 $8,151.50 $8,731.50
Demand Charge Per kVA of billing demand each $20.067 $18.088 $17.821
month
Energy Charge ¢/kWh 5.563¢ 5.508¢ 4.695¢

CUSTOMER-OWNED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge plus the demand charge.
BILLING DEMAND
The monthly billing demand shall be the greater of the monthly Recorded Demand or
the Reservation Capacity, but shall not be less than the maximum demand registered in the preceding 23 months.
